evidence_kind: Recovered DLL/PDB facts and bounded portable consumer integration; no original Windows execution or Android gameplay observed by this contract pass.
scope: Collision weapon requests, non-projectile wall damage, collision effect removal, external force, impact presentation and live Thing reflection. This is not a full game or full generic reflection contract.

facts: Equipped CollisionWeapon lookup precedes the Physics gate; absent weapon or Physics returns without a request.
Positive CollisionWeaponRequiredVelocity compares its square to Physics velocity components at +0x70/+0x74; moveShift is a separate field.
Damage is supplied collision speed times Unit CollisionDamagePerVelocity times Life collisionDamageMultiplier(+0x4c).
Only valid copied primary ProjectileData receives DamageLow(+0x2e0), DamageHigh(+0x2e4), and ImpactVelocity(+0x618); RequestFire still follows without valid primary projectile data.
RequestFire VA0x180083160 receives supplied angle, zero locations, null target, and applySelfEffects=true. Ordinary request rejection is not a reconstruction failure.
ClearOnCollisionEffects precedes collidee collision-weapon and initiator weapon requests.
Collidee FireCollisionWeapon is skipped when its last force was self-applied and AllowSelfCollisions is false; supplied angle is initiator body angle plus pi.
InitiatedCollisionWeapon requires equipped source weapon, Physics, self-applied last force, sufficient supplied speed and a different collidee; RequestFire retains the actual collidee entity link.
ApplyShift VA0x1802f81f0..0x1802f8237 has a separate initiated-weapon request with angle -1 and no target after obstacle collision.
Capture the active-effect vector at UnitStatus+0x50..+0x58; pending effects are excluded.
Each active effect whose source ClearOnCollision is true calls virtual Clear only when not already cleared.
Append the selected effect to deferred deletion even if already cleared; no immediate cleanup or legitimate weapon-request clearing occurs here.
First-contact presentation copies CollisionSound into owner-Thing PlayCue3D, starts CollisionAnimation, optionally fades alpha, and creates CollisionFx at obstacle virtual XY.
Bounce>=1 uses external vector force along the push normal with (bounce-1)*speed and CollisionKnockbackCap; smaller bounce scales reflected velocity.
Reaction-facing gate admits fixed wall damage and then positive per-velocity damage if the shared shift damage accumulator is nonpositive.
Both wall hits use the obstacle as source Thing and null Weapon, Projectile and Effect; only the per-velocity amount adds to the shared shift accumulator.
CollisionReactionFx uses CalcIntersectionPoint; CollisionKnockback uses the vector-force consumer; speed-gated DieOnCollision calls the real deferred Destroy path.
Supported core requires null Weapon, Projectile and Effect; source Thing may be the actual collision obstacle and is not fabricated.
Player-controlled Life applies DamageTakenMultiplier, then the live Life damage multiplier and native roundf semantics.
Projectile-only hit presentation, directional projectile block and projectile/weapon bonus bookkeeping are not invoked for this core.
Life dirty membership and DamagedAnimation occur before post-animation OwnerInvulnerable and NoInvulnerableCoverage reads.
Original attached victim OnHit receives the recovered hit arguments and owns health mutation; no native health subtraction substitutes for Lua.
OnHitWeapon uses actual equipped lookup, status gates/CanFireWhileDisarmed and the real RequestFire overload.
Every edge pair is tested; parallel or out-of-range intersections yield the native zero sentinel; nonzero intersection points are averaged.

Preserve the shipped asymmetric offset at VA0x1802cedeb..0x1802cee15: every current endpoint of polygon A receives the supplied offset, but its next endpoint receives that offset only for the closing edge.
VA0x1802cee02/0x1802cee07 add offset to the first vertex for the closing next endpoint; VA0x1802cee0f/0x1802cee15 load ordinary next endpoints without offset.
An intersection exactly at origin is excluded by the same zero-sentinel test; no accepted intersections returns zero.
Original Void action ID153: Name, Names and Ids are HasKey probes; actual selection uses singular numeric Id.
A Thing without Physics returns without allocating Physics.
UsingRadians defaults false; Angle defaults -1000000, degrees convert from float through double pi/180; Speed defaults zero, MaxSpeed defaults to Speed.
Angle-force VA0x1802bd070 receives footingLost=0; vector-force VA0x1802bd160 is shared by collision bounce and knockback.
Existing Physics consumers retain primary immobility, external-force multiplier, immunity, normalization, velocity cap and OnForce/component ordering.
Primary/Life invulnerability plus SilentImpactOnInvulnerable returns before presentation and sound.
CalcTipLocation precedes selection. A Unit critical hit selects CriticalFx; otherwise Unit vulnerability selects HitVulnerabilityFx.
Critical/vulnerability branch sets animation Z and prefers unmodified time, then returns before ImpactSound, including when animation creation returns no object (VA0x18006e16a/0x18006e18b).
Ordinary ImpactFx sets projectile Z, adds projectile body angle plus pi, and prefers unmodified time.
Ordinary ImpactSound still executes when ordinary animation creation returns no object (VA0x18006e1c8..0x18006e225), using the victim Thing as audio owner.
Distance reference is Thing spawn location(+0x90/+0x94), distinct from current location.
Polygon scan admits a vertex only for distanceSquared>best-1; distanceSquared>best+1 replaces the accumulated sum/count, otherwise adds to it.
Best distance updates for every admitted vertex, not only a strict maximum; accepted vertices are averaged in original traversal order.
Without the native polygon flag, return Thing::GetLocation; the portable implementation uses geometry presence as that flag representation.
Script SetThingProperty ID176 resolves ordinary DestinationIds/DestinationNames selection first, then reads DataValue (default true) and AllProjectiles (default false).
DataValue=false invokes live ReflectionHelper::SetProperty<Thing> at VA0x180280b40; data-copy assignment is Thing::SetThingProperty at VA0x1802e66d0 and remains distinct.
Portable supported live destinations are float timeMultiplier (ElapsedTimeMultiplier) and bool suppressSounds (SuppressSounds), using the existing primitive reflection mutation semantics.
AllProjectiles selects ProjectileManager active vector at native globals 0x181a0dfc0..0x181a0dfc8 instead of ordinary resolved targets; pending projectiles are excluded.
Both data/live native branches share active selection; portable projectile data-copy reflection remains explicitly unsupported.

CheckWithinDistanceAverage applies the existing distance predicate before optional StopsProjectiles/StopsUnits LOS. It retains source/destination means, UseLocationZ projection, no-destination completion, and no NotifyResultsTable write.
LOS ignores the first actual resolved destination Thing, uses Z=0 and LineOfSightBuffer; positive LineOfSightEndBuffer shortens the destination toward the source.
End-buffer square strictly larger than mean separation square completes immediately; equality shortens to the source, and equal endpoints return no blocker.

GridManager.GetLineOfSightBlocker selects StopsProjectiles grid list when requested, otherwise All; StopsUnits is an additional virtual stopping predicate. No Unit candidate scan substitutes for this obstacle query.
Positive Z skips only obstacles strictly shorter than it; equality remains eligible. StopsProjectiles excludes Life.ProjectilesAlwaysPenetrate; StopsUnits excludes Life.DieOnCollision.
Polygon.FromThickLine VA0x180062e10 uses the normalized segment direction and a perpendicular half-width: from+normal, to+normal, to-normal, from-normal.
Native zero width selects segment PolygonCollision VA0x1802ce630; nonzero width selects PolygonCollisionOpt VA0x1802cefd0. First qualifying obstacle is the blocker.
portable_adaptations: Existing sparse obstacle grid and transformed original polygons are reused. Conservative swept-line float AABB includes width because this grid also filters obstacle AABBs; native integer segment rectangle/cell/hash traversal is not claimed.

Thin line uses the existing portable projectile LOS containment/inclusive edge predicate; thick line uses the existing movement polygon-overlap predicate. Native floating instruction/contact-boundary equivalence remains unproven.
Source Thing+0x78 height is represented by the existing Thing.Tallness data projection. NotifyWithinDistance itself supplies zero Z, so nonzero-height adaptation is not exercised by this caller.
Portable candidate order replaces native cross-cell hash order; completion depends on presence of any blocker, not which blocker ID wins.
notify_line_of_sight.validation_status: Integrated bounded host replays; exact boundary coverage is not exhaustive.

portable_adaptations: Actual lifetime handles replace native pointer/entity encodings; no generated actor, source weapon or projectile is supplied.

Collision geometry and broadphase retain previously documented portable ordering/overlap approximations; CalcIntersectionPoint preserves the recovered endpoint asymmetry instead of symmetrically repairing it.
Impact audio uses existing owner-Thing spatial admission; PC PlayCue3D flag1/callback-vector storage is not represented separately.
Tip-location polygon flag is represented by existing portable geometry presence; Beam virtual end-location behavior is not replaced by the base tip calculation.
Lua error wrappers release C++ owners before Lua longjmp; unsupported/missing consumers remain explicit faults.
explicit_unsupported: Non-projectile TakeHit core does not accept Weapon/Projectile/Effect requests; existing projectile TakeHit remains a separate implementation pending full convergence.
Nonzero OnDamagedSpin, wall velocity absorption, unsupported effect factories/clear providers and the inherited collision reaction callback-schema approximation remain boundaries.
ApplyForce nonboolean UsingRadians/SelfApplied arguments are rejected rather than assigned unproven coercion semantics.
Live Thing reflection beyond ElapsedTimeMultiplier/SuppressSounds, projectile data-copy reflection and unsupported primitive change modes remain explicit.
BeamProjectile CalcTipLocation requires the actual beam end location.

AllProjectiles during a synchronous callback inside projectile-manager in-place compaction may see transient disposed or duplicate slots. The native manager also compacts in place (VA0x180079275..0x1800792e7). Portable disposed active entries produce an explicit lifecycle fault; no unproven deduplication/order rewrite is claimed.
No per-device correctness, later-biome completeness or full game stability follows from source integration.
